deduplication_rule: rownames must be unique; duplicate source rows are rejected
grouping_rule: strict source order with rolling train/calibration/test origins fixed by REGISTERED_PROTOCOL.json
known_source_dependence: serial dependence is expected and is modeled through the registered plug-in AR(1) primary plus iid sensitivity
license_status: The official wooldridge data package distributes fish as package content and declares GPL-3. This CSV is conveyed separately under GPL-3 to the extent that package licence applies. Rdatasets states that its GPL declaration covers its code/documentation and that it could not definitively determine the underlying rights in every hosted dataset; that caveat is retained.
rights_basis: The official GPL-3 wooldridge data package distributes the fish table as package content; the CSV is an Rdatasets serialization of that table.
processed_filename: not_persisted; deterministic roles and transformations are emitted in each result directory
processed_sha256: not_applicable; generated products are hashed by run_manifest.json
redistribution_decision: Bundled as a separately licensed GPL-3 fixture to the extent applicable, with the complete GPL-3 text, preferred-form CSV, official package and Rdatasets source links, Graddy attribution, and the Rdatasets underlying-rights caveat. The repository MIT licence is not applied to this file.
retrieval_method: byte-identical Rdatasets CSV serialization of the fish table distributed by the official wooldridge package and reused from the tutorial fixture
retrieval_timestamp_utc: unknown: the exact upstream retrieval time was not retained; the byte identity is fixed by SHA256
selection_rule: all 97 ordered complete rows are retained; prediction begins at the fixed 65th observation
source_citation: K. Graddy, Testing for Imperfect Competition at the Fulton Fish Market, RAND Journal of Economics 26 (1995), 75-92; Rdatasets wooldridge::fish export
study_role: rolling conditional one-step calibration and prediction
transform_code_commit: not recorded; per-run source-file SHA256 values are recorded instead

units.avgprc: source-native positive price unit; no currency rescaling is introduced
